items.author: CaffinatedAK
items.text:
My bots just got their own email addresses.

Until now every one of them was borrowing mine. Mr. Paperwork sends from my Gmail, and the Loggr bot posts through my X session. As of this week's Grok Bot update, a bot can claim its own inbox, and it can search X without needing my login.

The part that makes me okay with it: anything a bot sends from its own address still lands as a draft card I have to approve. It gets its own identity, but it doesn't get to send whatever it wants.

What I'll try first: give the Shopping Expert its own address and let it go back and forth with a seller while all I do is tap approve.

zh-TW.summary: 作者稱本週更新後，Grok Bot 可為每個 bot 領取獨立收件匣，且可在不登入其 X 帳號的情況下搜尋 X。此前 Mr. Paperwork 借用其 Gmail、Loggr 走其 X 工作階段。從獨立地址發出的內容仍會落成需其點批准的草稿卡；他打算先給 Shopping Expert 獨立地址，讓它與賣家往來、自己只點批准。

Previously Mr. Paperwork sent from his Gmail and Loggr posted through his X session. Mail from a bot's own address still lands as a draft card he must approve. He plans to give Shopping Expert its own address and only tap approve while it talks to sellers.

vi.summary: Sau bản cập nhật Grok Bot tuần này, bot có thể nhận hộp thư riêng và tìm X mà không cần đăng nhập của tác giả. Trước đó Mr. Paperwork dùng Gmail của anh và Loggr dùng phiên X của anh. Thư từ địa chỉ bot vẫn thành thẻ nháp cần duyệt. Anh định cho Shopping Expert địa chỉ riêng và chỉ bấm duyệt khi nó trao đổi với người bán.

items.text:
Grok Bot 的电脑可以重置，它攒下的技能和规则不能丢。今天我照着雨哥这条的思路，把它整台电脑的「家当」每天自动备份进了一个私有 GitHub 仓库，第一次推送约 1200 个文件、78MB。

我的做法和原帖有一处不同，其他基本照抄：

1. 登录用 gh 的设备码方式，不往聊天框里贴 token。网页上输一次性码，再过一遍 GitHub 账号的两步验证。我第一次卡在找不到那个 6 位码：它是你账号自己的 2FA，在验证器 App 或短信里，网页不会弹出来。设备码 15 分钟过期，过期重新生成就行。
要说清楚：gh 登录后，电脑上会存一个能访问你所有仓库的令牌，权限比原帖那种只限一个仓库的 fine-grained token 大。介意的话，还是用原帖的方法更稳。

2. 新建私有仓库，用 gh repo view 确认是 PRIVATE 再推。

3. 备份什么：技能、routine 日志、各类内容草稿、bot 之间的交接文件、调研资料。

4. 不备份什么：.env、token/secret/cookie、密钥文件、数据库、个人资料原件、超过 20MB 的音视频。

5. 推之前再扫一遍敏感串：ghp_、sk-、AKIA、BEGIN PRIVATE KEY、Bearer、api_key=。今天命中 1 个文档网页，多半只是示例，也照样排除了。宁可少备一个文件。

6. 节奏：每天凌晨自动跑一次；技能或规则一改，马上补一次；没变化就不提交。

我的感受：给 bot 干活久了，真正值钱的不是电脑，是它记住的规则、踩过的坑和那套技能。这些没备份，重置一次就得从头教。私有仓库也不等于可以乱放东西，密钥这类一律别进 git。
outline: Login with gh device code (no token in chat); complete GitHub 2FA; device code expires in 15 minutes
Create a private repo; confirm PRIVATE with gh repo view before push
Back up: skills, routine logs, drafts, handoff files, research notes
Do not back up: .env, tokens/secrets/cookies, key files, databases, personal originals, audio/video over 20MB
Scan for sensitive strings before push (ghp_, sk-, AKIA, BEGIN PRIVATE KEY, Bearer, api_key=)
Schedule: auto run daily at dawn; push immediately when skills/rules change; skip if unchanged

This guy used Grok Bot to build a two-sided market-making system on Polymarket

Result: +$179,327

The system trades BTC Up/Down markets with an average trade size of $52.78 and 112.5 trades per active hour

It places limit orders for both outcomes, builds complete sets for less than $1, and manages the remaining directional exposure

Six AI agents work together as one system:

> SCAN: Tracks prices on both sides, the spread, liquidity, and time until the market closes

> QUOTE: Sets bid prices and order sizes for Up and Down, updating them as the market moves and inventory changes

> PAIR: Calculates the combined cost of each Up/Down pair and identifies complete sets below $1

> BALANCE: Manages directional exposure from unpaired shares

> EXEC: Places, cancels, and replaces orders. Tracks fills and shares updated position data with the other agents

> AUDIT: Reviews results, measures how much edge remains after rebalancing, and identifies opportunities to improve efficiency

Each agent has ongoing responsibilities and its own working context

Handoffs connect the stages
Skills store the workflow rules
Routines run checks and generate reports

This trader’s Polymarket account: Polkadot-Frog

The edge of this six-agent system depends on the combined cost of both outcomes and execution quality. Rebalancing reduces the remaining directional exposure

en.title: Dot cloud PC: Chrome shows download done but file missing
